subject: planner: shallow copy more field for Instance Plan Cache to improve performance (#57201)
summary: Reviewed the plan-cache cloning changes (CloneForPlanCache + generator) and the runtime rebuild path (RebuildPlan4CachedPlan). The new shallow copies (scan ranges, schemas, partition helper fields) are either overwritten during rebuild or treated as read-only in execution; mutable per-execution state (e.g., point/batch-point handles/index values, index-join inner-worker scratch constants) remains per-session/per-worker. Scanned later history on upstream/master for follow-ups touching these files; no evidence of a later fix suggesting a missed Blocker/High issue in this commit.
